records.text: Thy wraths passed over me, and Thy threats utterly troubled me;
they encircled me like water all day; together they closed around me.
Thou didst remove friend and neighbor far from me, and my acquaintances because of misery.
Then Job replied:
“So you are the people! Surely wisdom will die with you!
I too have a heart like yours.
For a righteous and blameless man became an object of mockery.
For at an appointed time he was prepared to fall beneath others, and for his houses to be plundered by the lawless.
But indeed, let no wicked person trust that he will be innocent, nor those who provoke the Lord suppose that there will be no examination of them.
But ask the four-footed animals, to see whether they will tell you, and the birds of heaven, to see whether they will report to you.
Speak fully to the earth, to see whether it will tell you; and the fish of the sea will explain to you.
Who among all these did not know that the Lord’s hand made these things?
Is not the life of all living things in His hand, and the breath of every human being?
For the ear discerns words, and the throat tastes food.
In much time is wisdom, and in a long life knowledge.
With Him are wisdom and power; to Him belong counsel and understanding.
If He restrains water, He will dry the earth; if He lets it loose, He destroys it by overturning it.
With Him are might and strength; to Him belong knowledge and understanding.

Become witnesses for Me—and I too am a witness, says the Lord God, and the servant whom I chose—so that you may know, believe, and understand that I am. Before Me no other god came to be, nor will there be one after Me.
I am God, and apart from Me there is no one who saves.
I announced and saved; I reproached, and there was no foreign one among you. You are witnesses for Me, and I too am a witness, says the Lord God,
But grant me two things; then I will not hide from Thy face:
Keep Thy hand away from me, and let Thy terror not overwhelm me.
Then Thou wilt call, and I will answer Thee; or Thou wilt speak, and I will give Thee a reply.
How many are my sins and lawless deeds? Teach me what they are.
Why dost Thou hide from me and regard me as opposed to Thee?
For Thou didst record evils against me and put the sins of youth around me.
Thou didst put my foot in a restraint and watch all my works; Thou didst reach to the roots of my feet.
It grows old like a wineskin, or like a moth-eaten garment.
For He will meet those doing what is just, and they will remember Thy ways. Behold, Thou becamest angry, and we sinned; therefore we went astray.
There is no one calling on Thy name or remembering to take hold of Thee, because Thou didst turn Thy face away from us and didst hand us over because of our sins.
But now, Lord, Thou art our Father, and we are clay, all the work of Thy hands.
Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
I will report to you—hear me; what I have seen I will report to you,
what wise people will say; they did not conceal their fathers.
To them alone the land was given, and no foreigner came upon them.
His fear is in his ears; when he thinks he is already at peace, his overthrow will come.
Let him not trust that he will turn back from darkness, for he has already been assigned to the hands of iron,
and he has been assigned as food for vultures. He knows within himself that he remains destined to fall. A dark day will whirl him about,
and distress and affliction will hold him fast, like a general falling in the front rank,
because he raised his hands against the Lord and stiffened his neck before the Lord Almighty,
and ran against Him in insolence, with the thick back of his shield,
because he covered his face with his fat and made a collar upon his thighs.
May he lodge in deserted cities and enter uninhabited houses; what those people prepared, others will carry away.
He will certainly not become rich, nor will his belongings remain; he will not cast a shadow upon the earth
nor will he escape darkness. May wind wither his shoot, and may his flower fall away.
His cutting will be destroyed before its time, and his shoot will not grow dense.
May he be harvested like an unripe grape before its time; may he fall like an olive blossom.
For death is the testimony of an ungodly person, and fire will burn the houses of those who take bribes.
He will conceive pains in the womb; empty things will result for him, and his belly will bear deceit.”
I have seen his ways, healed him, comforted him, and given him true comfort—
peace upon peace to those far away and those near. And the Lord said, ‘I will heal them.’
Hope in Him, all the assembly of the people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our helper. Diapsalma.
God spoke once; these two things I heard:
that power belongs to God, and mercy unto Thee, Lord, for Thou wilt repay each one according to his works.
Then Job replied:
“I have heard many such things; you are all comforters of evils.
What then? Is there any order in words of wind? What will trouble you, that you answer?
I too will speak as you do, if your life were put in place of mine. Then I will leap upon you with words and shake my head against you.
May there be strength in my mouth; I will not spare the movement of my lips.
Yet there was nothing unjust in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
Earth, do not cover the blood of my flesh, and let there be no place for my cry!
May my supplication reach the Lord, and may my eye drip tears before Him.
May there be a hearing for a man before the Lord, and may a son of man plead for his neighbor.
The numbered years have come, and I will travel a way on which I will not return.
For the end. For Jeduthun. A song of David.
I said, “I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue.” I placed a guard upon my mouth when the sinner stood against me.
“Make known to me, Lord, my limit and the number of my days, what it is, so that I may know what I lack.
Behold, Thou madest my days handbreadths, and my existence is as nothing before Thee. Yet all things are vanity—every living person. Diapsalma.
Indeed a person passes through as an image; yet they are troubled in vain. He stores treasure and does not know for whom he will gather it.
And now, what is my expectation? Is it not the Lord? And my existence comes from Thee.
First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is proclaimed in the whole world.
For I long to see you, to share with you some spiritual gift so that you may be strengthened,
that is, to be encouraged together among you through one another’s faith, both yours and mine.
My days passed in a stench, and the joints of my heart were torn apart.
They made night into day; light is near in the face of darkness.
For if I wait, Hades is my house, and in gloom my bedding is spread.
Where, then, is my hope any longer? Will I see my good things?
Will they go down with me to Hades, or will we descend together upon a mound of earth?”
Son, guard my words, and hide my commandments with yourself.
Son, honor the Lord and you will be strong; apart from Him, fear no other.
Guard my commandments and you will live, and my words like the pupils of eyes.
Put them around your fingers; inscribe them on the broad surface of your heart.
so that she may keep you from an alien and wicked woman, if she catches you with pleasing words.
Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
An extraordinary fall has been prepared for him.
May healing burst away from his dwelling, and may distress hold him on a royal charge.
It will lodge in his tent during his night; his splendid things will be strewn with sulfur.
Below, his roots will dry up; above, his harvest will fall.
May his memorial perish from the earth, yet he has a name on the outer face of the land.
May he thrust him from light into darkness.
Those who came last groaned over him, and astonishment seized those who came first.
These are the houses of the unjust, and this is the place of those who do not know the Lord.”
The foolish and senseless will perish together and leave their wealth to strangers.
Their tombs are their houses for ever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they invoked their names upon their lands.
A person, though in honor, did not understand; he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.
This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them, and afterward they will take delight with their mouth. Diapsalma.
But God will redeem my soul from Hades’ hand when He receives me. Diapsalma.
For thus says the Lord: Glean, glean Israel’s remnants like a vine; turn back like the grape-gatherer to his basket.

To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear. Behold, the Lord’s utterance became a reproach to them; they certainly will not wish to hear it.
